name: Sam Okafor
summary: Platform engineer focused on container infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, and making deploys boring through automation.

bullets: Operate Kubernetes clusters on AWS with zero-downtime rolling deploys.
Wrote Terraform modules for networking and service accounts adopted by five teams.
Containerized legacy services with Docker and migrated them onto the shared cluster.
Managed AWS accounts, IAM policies, and backup automation.
Built Python tooling for fleet inventory and patch reporting.

projects.name: Cluster Bootstrap
projects.description: Terraform and shell scripts that spin up a demo Kubernetes cluster.
bullets: Terraform provisions AWS resources; Docker images ship with the demo workloads.
Documented the Git-based promotion flow for environment changes.
